# Top100

> The 100 most-starred GitHub repositories for 30 programming languages, rebuilt every hour from the GitHub Search API and published as raw newline-delimited JSON you can download without an API key.

Top100 answers "what are the top GitHub repositories by stars right now?" for 30 languages. Every page carries the timestamp of the refresh that produced it. Each JSONL line is the complete, unmodified repository object GitHub returned: owner, licence, topics, every count and every timestamp.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://havaianasdestruido.github.io/top100/index.html): the current overall top 10, the language index, star-threshold statistics and the FAQ
- [All 30 languages](https://havaianasdestruido.github.io/top100/languages/index.html): every top 100 list with entry star counts and medians

## Reference

- [Methodology](https://havaianasdestruido.github.io/top100/methodology.html): the exact Search API query, refresh cadence, rate limits and known limitations
- [Dataset field reference](https://havaianasdestruido.github.io/top100/dataset.html): every field in the JSONL files, plus download and DuckDB/pandas/jq examples
- [Comparison](https://havaianasdestruido.github.io/top100/compare.html): Top100 vs GitHub Trending, gitstar-ranking.com, EvanLi/Github-Ranking, OSS Insight, Star History, GH Archive and BigQuery
- [FAQ](https://havaianasdestruido.github.io/top100/faq.html): sixteen questions with direct answers

## Data

- JSONL files (30 files, 100 records each, 3,000 total): https://github.com/havaianasdestruido/top100/tree/main/data/JSONL
- Raw download pattern: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/havaianasdestruido/top100/main/data/JSONL/python.jsonl
- Markdown tables: https://github.com/havaianasdestruido/top100/tree/main/data
- Update feed (RSS): https://havaianasdestruido.github.io/top100/feed.xml

## Notes

- Refreshed hourly by a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow; the data is GitHub API output and every repository keeps its own licence.
- Source code and workflow: https://github.com/havaianasdestruido/top100
- No JavaScript, no tracking, no cookies, no external requests.
